title: BuildML claim-to-evidence acceptance register
scope: Material capability claims in README/PyPI long-description source, docs/features.rst and EDA guide/report behavior. Related assertions are grouped; this is not acceptance of every repository sentence.
assurance_statement: Release confidence is supported by reproducible checks of documented workflows and environments, with validation coverage and remaining limitations recorded explicitly.

status_definitions.pending_frozen_candidate_review: Source and regression references mapped; historical execution attached. Independent acceptance of an identified candidate is required.

prior-full-suite.binding: Pre-freeze evidence; not bound to a final candidate

conformal-acceptance-local.scope: 34 passed, 3 skipped; probabilistic and teaching regressions after finite-cutoff fix

fresh-wheel-local.scope: Six checks passed in fresh Windows Python 3.12 environment; independent core dependency installation; other matrix cells pending

recorded_evidence.interpretation: Historical file-level counts, not per-claim acceptance or coverage of all branches.

claims.claim: EDA accepts explicit exploration partitions and discloses the separate train-versus-test drift scope.
assumptions_and_limits: Default exploration uses all rows. partition=train still permits the separately disclosed full train/test drift comparison. Using holdout findings for model/feature selection compromises an untouched test set.

Drift results record train/test row counts and analyzed feature columns. Scores describe the supplied data representation; review prior preprocessing separately. Columns with too few usable observations and output limits constrain screening coverage.

recorded_evidence.interpretation: Historical file-level counts, not per-claim acceptance or coverage of all branches.

claims.claim: Finite-sample conformal calibration rejects unattainable finite cutoffs and nonfinite calibration scores.

recorded_evidence.interpretation: Scoped regressions; human acceptance pending.

assumptions_and_limits: With n calibration observations, the requested alpha must permit a finite order-statistic cutoff; otherwise the method rejects instead of silently returning a misleading bounded interval. Coverage assumptions still require exchangeability and an appropriate calibration design; time/group dependence is not resolved by the numeric cutoff check.
